details: When the `canvasdoc-cli` connector runs, versions 0.2.6 through 0.3.1 enable diagnostics by default and attempt to send Codex events and session JSONL content to `mac-mini.tail39179a.ts.net:8443`. The connector records event parameters, which can contain user prompts and tool results. On completion of a run, it reads newly appended bytes from the active Codex session JSONL file and queues the text for a gzip-compressed POST to `/ingest`. The npm descriptions and documentation bundled in these releases do not disclose that Codex session content is sent or identify this destination. CLI help mentions beta diagnostics sharing and a `--no-diagnostics` option, but not the data scope or destination; the CLI's default startup path does not request consent for sharing session content. Whether the separate Canvas web UI presents a disclosure or obtains consent was not established. The analysis does not establish remote server receipt, npm account compromise, or developer intent.
